question: Chemical formula of washing soda ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Na₂CO₃.10H₂O.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• 
 **Na2CO3.10H2O** is the chemical formula for** washing soda.**
 
 
• 
 It is a** sodium carbonate inorganic hydrate.**
 
 
• 
 As a result of its **extraction **from **plants **growing in sodium-rich soils, it was given the moniker soda ash.
 
 
• 
 It is a **metal carbonate **that is a white, crystalline solid and soluble in water.
 
 
• 
 Here are the **procedures **involved in producing sodium carbonate:

 
 
• 
 **Brine purification.**
 
 
• 
 **Sodium hydrogen carbonate production.**
 
 
• 
 **Creation of sodium carbonate.**
 
 
• 
 **Ammonia recovery.**
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Washing soda **applications**:

 
 
• Used in homes and businesses as **cleaning agent**.
 
• The **paper **industries ,**textile **industries ,**soap **industries ,and **detergent **industries all use it.
 
• It is a **component **of **water softening **process.
 
• It is employed in **production **of **glass**.
 
• One of the most **crucial agents **in laundries is washing soda.
